title: Why Trump's Russian diesel U-turn helps India, for now

scenes.title: Trump buys Russian diesel. Why India gains, for now
scenes.say: Donald Trump is buying diesel from Russia. It's a stunning U-turn, and for now, it helps India.

scenes.title: US pump prices, per gallon, in a year
scenes.say: The reason is American pump prices. In a year, petrol has gone from $3 to $4.3 a gallon. Diesel has nearly doubled, to over $6.
scenes.speak: The reason is American pump prices. In a year, petrol has gone from three dollars to four dollars thirty a gallon. Diesel has nearly doubled, to over six dollars.

scenes.label: Trump's approval, CNN Poll of Polls, ahead of the November midterms
scenes.source: CNN Poll of Polls, via The Secretariat
scenes.say: Diesel hurts farmers and truckers, Trump's core voters. And his approval is down to 34%, just before the midterms.
scenes.speak: Diesel hurts farmers and truckers, Trump's core voters. And his approval is down to thirty-four per cent, just before the midterms.

scenes.title: Russian diesel for America
scenes.say: The deal: 300,000 tonnes of Russian diesel first, then 500,000 in November, and a million tonnes in December.
scenes.speak: The deal: three hundred thousand tonnes of Russian diesel first, then five hundred thousand in November, and a million tonnes in December.

scenes.title: Can Moscow even deliver?
scenes.say: But Ukrainian strikes have hit Russia's refineries so hard that Moscow recently bought emergency fuel from India itself.

scenes.label: Brent crude, a barrel, close to this level on Hormuz and Houthi fears
scenes.say: All this as fears over Hormuz and Houthi attacks push Brent crude close to $110 a barrel.
scenes.speak: All this as fears over Hormuz and Houthi attacks push Brent crude close to a hundred and ten dollars a barrel.

scenes.title: A breather, for now
items: 60-day pause on the Graham tariff law
The trade deal may be close
scenes.say: For India, it's a breather. A 60-day pause on Senator Graham's tariff law, less pressure over Russian oil, and a trade deal that may finally be close.
scenes.speak: For India, it's a breather. A sixty-day pause on Senator Graham's tariff law, less pressure over Russian oil, and a trade deal that may finally be close.

scenes.text: This round has gone India's way. The next may not.
scenes.role: After Sushma Ramachandran in The Secretariat
scenes.say: But Washington's swings have cost India before, on tariffs and energy. This round went India's way. The next may not.
